answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond in a shared vault before it can transact, and make that bond unlock only after a long reputation horizon. A genuine agent builds a costly signal: consistent, useful work over weeks that cannot be faked quickly. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand bonds and wait the same horizon for each, so the cost scales linearly while the benefit does not. If a fake is caught, its bond is slashed, making mass forgery unprofitable.
